summary.text: Dumont Walker is the Democratic candidate for Georgia House of Representatives District 46 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent John Carson (R).
He has worked in marketing and communications for nearly two decades and lists lowering costs, affordable healthcare and education as priorities.

paragraphs.text: Dumont Walker earned a high school diploma from Nelson County High School and a bachelor's degree from Xavier University in 2005.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he was raised in central Virginia by his mother after his father's passing and has worked in marketing and communications, helping nonprofits.
Walker named cost of living as his top priority, along with affordable healthcare and education access, including improving literacy, reducing class sizes and paying teachers more.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on May 19, 2026.
